CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2528 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c. Bus nonce: a4b5dbaef6567264e63d26d8b844d291. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c` or `Fix review: blocked 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: a4b5dbaef6567264e63d26d8b844d291`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2528 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2528-a4b5dbae`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2528 (branch fix/r10-prepr-closures, group R10-PREPR-CLOSURES) at head 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c, after fixer round fix2528x on the blocked verdict at 10f85c3ee706 (carry-missing). The round changed the body only: the carry is routed to R10-FLOW-JIDOKA, whose brief on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster now cites #2528 ("Carry from #2528 (R10-PREPR-CAP) ..."). The code delta since the reviewed head is main merges only: confirm with git log --no-merges 10f85c3ee7065d31230e292d7438e105efb9ff57..1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c --not origin/main (expect empty) and git diff 10f85c3ee7065d31230e292d7438e105efb9ff57...1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c against main's own changes.
Read every open block with `git fetch origin review/2528; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` and confirm each is cleared at this head. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head, with the finder's harness (the earlier verdict's ev/ tree), never the fixer's. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required: the earlier mutation proof still holds at this head (re-run it); every body figure re-measured at this head; carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body reports 0 unrouted and every carry names a live group (stage not done); ## Red checks from the check-runs API per commit at this head (nightly-status grades main; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT); git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c clean. ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: a4b5dbaef6567264e63d26d8b844d291.
